image_prompt.text: The ordered run through the section: a chain of dark gray primitive-block platforms and ramps on a raised platform, spaced within jump limits from the ramp entrance to the far end
Blocky dark red and dark gray obstacles to jump over along the raised platform, with ramps stepping the route up and back down
Barrier walls of plain dark gray blocks flanking the platform and narrowing it into a challenging path

notes: Preset Classic Obby taken on its own shape course-flat, with obstacle-moving dropped (the prompt specifies static primitive shapes - ramps, blocks, barrier walls, nothing rotating or sliding) and checkpoint-respawn dropped (a single course section, no failure or respawn described).

The horror survival framing ('for a horror survival game like Forsaken ASYM') is treated as art direction rather than a second genre: the deliverable is one parkour obstacle course section, and nothing survival-specific - killer, hiding, resources, escape objective - is described. Recorded here so the pipeline keeps the theme.
Art direction: dark gray with dark red accents, built entirely from simple primitive shapes.

The prompt asks to expose attributes for course length, obstacle height, and platform width. No layout option carries parameters, so these need to reach the builder as exposed attributes on the generated section.
